decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost pricing tier of the established anamnesis app that serves larger practices and fits the firm's digitalisation path. No shortfall against aspirations is evident, so there is no trigger for problemistic search, and slack from the broad installed base easily carries it.

A dedicated support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's core strength in customer service and strengthens retention of its user base. With its own web page and no sign of underperformance, management has no reason to search for other uses of these resources.
